title: Video gets easier to make
summary:
Video generation arrived in chat, Enter made tiers and search-capable models clearer, and app submissions gained a review workflow.

Chat added video generation through `/video` or the attachment menu, with model selection and playback in the conversation. The video API now selects Seedance’s image-to-video model when an image is supplied and accepts numeric durations beyond the previous 4, 6, and 8-second restriction, subject to provider limits.

Enter’s tier panel now lays out the Spore → Seed → Flower → Nectar progression, daily Pollen amounts, and tier requirements. The FAQ also explains how daily grants are spent and when they expire.

Enter’s model pricing table now marks Gemini Search and two Perplexity models with a web-search icon.

highlights.title: Make videos in chat
highlights.text: Use `/video` or the attachment menu to pick a video model, generate a clip, and play it in the conversation. A first-visit tutorial covers the basics. [Try chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: See how Pollen tiers work
highlights.text: Enter’s tier panel now shows the Spore → Seed → Flower → Nectar progression, daily Pollen amounts, and what each tier requires.
